items.headline: Brandin Podziemski Inks 5-Year, $110 Million Extension with Warriors
items.summary: Golden State Warriors guard Brandin Podziemski has reportedly agreed to a five-year, $110 million contract extension. The deal locks in the polarizing combo guard, who shot 37% from three last season, at approximately $22 million per year.

items.headline: Warriors Take Down Lakers in Las Vegas Preseason Clash
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors defeated the Los Angeles Lakers 101-89 in a preseason contest held in Las Vegas. The game further highlighted Las Vegas' growing potential as an NBA destination.

items.headline: NBA Unveils Custom Court Designs for 2026 Emirates NBA Cup
items.summary: The NBA has revealed striking custom-designed, fully painted courts for the 2026 Emirates NBA Cup. Inspired by Nike Basketball's 'End of Ordinary' collection, these courts will feature oversized team wordmarks and the host team's primary icon at center court, creating a bold visual experience for the tournament beginning October 30th.
